key_findings: Review of hydrogels as delivery and microenvironment-modulating platforms for intervertebral disc degeneration, with preclinical and early clinical support.
IVDD pathology involves NLRP3/Caspase-1/GSDMD pyroptosis, Nrf2/HO-1 antioxidant loss and TNF-alpha driven ECM degradation.
